entry_invariant: Any conversation entering an Enterprise Math RESEARCHER or RESEARCH_DRIVER role must resolve or allocate its role identity before substantive work begins. Researchers expose Researcher-ID; Drivers expose Driver-ID. Research mode is separate typed state.
final_response_invariant: While an Enterprise Math RESEARCHER or RESEARCH_DRIVER role is active, every assistant final response ends with exactly one role-appropriate identity marker. Registration state never suppresses this obligation.
entry_events: scheduler/PUBLISH by a researcher or Driver
resume of an existing Enterprise Math conversation
resolution_order: reuse the role identity already visible in the current conversation if one exists
reuse an unambiguous persisted role identity bound to this same conversation/session if available
for Driver-mediated manual relay, use the Researcher-ID preallocated in the dispatch envelope
for scheduler CLAIM, derive a deterministic Researcher-ID from task identity lane plus claim_id
otherwise generate a new role-appropriate short-code ID locally and persist it in the current conversation

lane_resolution.fallback: derive the compact Rxxx/Pxxx lane from task_id; otherwise use DIRECT

manual_dispatch.scope: Driver-mediated user relay into a new task-researcher conversation
manual_dispatch.derivation: SHA-256(task_id + NUL + dispatch_id), uppercase first 6 hex characters, prefixed by EM-<LANE>-
manual_dispatch.first_use: receiving conversation preserves the preallocated Researcher-ID from first use

scheduler_publish.rule: Use the already-resolved role identity as publisher_id. PUBLISH registers provenance; it neither changes role/mode nor authorizes execution.

scheduler_claim.derivation: SHA-256(task_id + NUL + claim_id), uppercase first 6 hex characters, prefixed by EM-<LANE>-

scheduler_review.cross_review: scheduler V2 rejects an accepting DISPATCH review from the same Driver-ID that published the task and rejects self-review of execution identity on RETURN

role_transition.same_conversation: preserve execution handle and switch visible role label/mode; update Research-Role / Research-Mode / Research-Task metadata and use the new footer template
role_transition.task_to_free_same_conversation: identity may be preserved but the free run is ANCHOR_EXPOSED unless context was independently clean before discovery began
role_transition.free_to_task_same_conversation: identity may be preserved; once an explicit READY task is accepted/claimed, switch to TASK_RESEARCH and normal task context may be loaded
role_transition.primary_driver: EM-DRIVER-01 only when conversation is explicitly the primary Driver continuity conversation

taskbook_contract.research_mode: TASK_RESEARCH after accepted dispatch/claim; task publication alone does not force mode transition
taskbook_contract.rule: Taskbooks declare identity policy/lane, never a fixed runtime Researcher-ID. Publisher identity lives in scheduler PUBLISH; claim identity lives in CLAIM; Driver identity lives in REVIEW.

registration.registration_failure: REGISTER_PENDING; continue work and persist the role identity visibly; retry only at a semantic checkpoint
registration.legacy_path_name_note: historical folder name researchers/ is retained for compatibility and may contain Driver identity records
